direction.title: A preview pane beside the list
direction.description: Split the launcher: a narrow list on the left and, on the right, a pane that shows the selected command large with its keys and how often it ran.

title: Side pane with usage
summary: Splits the body into a list and a 172 px pane: a 56 px icon, the name, description, keycaps, how often it ran and a Run button.
